evidence.quote: in recent years forecasters and policymakers have been surprised by the decline in the unemployment rate and the size of the sustained ongoing gains in payroll employment.
they have drifted lower over time as labor market conditions have improved and inflation has remained quiescent.
We will share our findings with the public when we have completed our review, likely during the first half of next year.
